note: Live-session recording of the SharePoint episode screens (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Set MG_TENANT, MG_UPN_DOMAIN and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID in the environment before queueing (never in a file). Sign-ins are device-code, done by the owner. Episodes 1-9 chain: set MG_KEEP_CHAIN=1 while recording them in order so teardown keeps what the next episode uses; unset it for a full clean-up. Needs labadmin as site collection admin on /sites/Purchasing (episode 3).
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
if (-not (Get-PnPWeb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'Purchasing site not reachable: record episode 03 first (MG_KEEP_CHAIN=1)' }
foreach ($c in 'Supplier File','Contract','Invoice','Purchasing Document') { Remove-PnPContentType -Identity $c -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

steps: Hold on the four Supplier File document sets: Adventure Works, Fabrikam, Northwind Traders, Tailspin Toys
Show a view with Name, Content type, Contract number, Expiry date, Department and Document ID
Check the Expiry date equals the day in the file name
Open the New menu: only Contract and Invoice are offered (no generic Document)
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar
Document ID prefix if it reveals the tenant
Modified By / Checked out to names
